experience_findings.evidence: The first hierarchy is the company People AI promise and all five connected maps; Exploration Camp is presented as the current starting position, not the product identity.

Visitor, active, expired, and unlocked states each expose one state-appropriate primary action; the visitor action validates a complete invitation on the home page instead of opening an empty /join.
